name: ui-record
description: What one UI component looks like in each state of a scripted session, recorded deterministically in headless Chromium. Never cached.

verbs.name: capture
verbs.description: Run a ui-steps file against its page and record each state: a settled screenshot, frames, the DOM without scripts, computed styles, and animations. Prints each settled screenshot path, one per line, or the recording with --json.

steps.description: A ui-steps JSON file, as contracts/ui-steps.schema.json defines it.

url.description: Record this URL instead of the steps file's url, such as a rebuild's preview.
